mapper.select: SELECT FROM merchant_application WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT a.id,a.application_no,a.owner_user_id,a.reserved_merchant_id,a.status,a.current_revision_id,a.submitted_revision_id,a.current_review_task_id,a.current_decision_id,a.current_decision_type,a.review_audit_id,a.current_credit_claim_id,a.current_identity_claim_id,a.subject_verification_status,a.version,a.submitted_at,a.reviewed_at, (d.id IS NOT NULL AND d.decision_type='APPROVE' AND d.submitted_revision_id=a.submitted_revision_id AND au.id IS NOT NULL AND r.id IS NOT NULL AND t.id IS NOT NULL AND t.status='CLOSED' AND ce.id IS NOT NULL AND ie.id IS NOT NULL AND cc.id IS NOT NULL AND ic.id IS NOT NULL AND ce.identifier_lookup_digest=d.credit_evidence_digest AND cc.lookup_digest=d.credit_evidence_digest AND ce.lookup_policy_slot=cc.lookup_policy_slot AND ce.lookup_key_version=cc.lookup_key_version AND ie.identifier_lookup_digest=d.identity_evidence_digest AND ic.lookup_digest=d.identity_evidence_digest AND ie.lookup_policy_slot=ic.lookup_policy_slot AND ie.lookup_key_version=ic.lookup_key_version AND ce.credential_type='CREDIT_CODE' AND ie.credential_type='IDENTITY_NUMBER' AND d.decided_by_operator_id=t.claimed_by_operator_id AND au.actor_id=d.decided_by_operator_id AND mer.id IS NOT NULL AND profile.merchant_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM merchant_store s WHERE s.merchant_id=a.reserved_merchant_id)) AS chain_valid FROM merchant_application a LEFT JOIN merchant_application_review_decision d ON d.application_id=a.id AND d.id=a.current_decision_id LEFT JOIN merchant_application_audit au ON au.application_id=a.id AND au.id=a.review_audit_id AND au.decision_id=d.id LEFT JOIN merchant_application_revision r ON r.application_id=a.id AND r.id=a.submitted_revision_id LEFT JOIN merchant_application_review_task t ON t.application_id=a.id AND t.id=a.current_review_task_id AND t.submitted_revision_id=r.id LEFT JOIN merchant_credential_evidence ce ON ce.application_id=a.id AND ce.revision_id=a.submitted_revision_id AND ce.id=d.credit_evidence_id AND ce.evidence_status='VERIFIED' LEFT JOIN merchant_credential_evidence ie ON ie.application_id=a.id AND ie.revision_id=a.submitted_revision_id AND ie.id=d.identity_evidence_id AND ie.evidence_status='VERIFIED' LEFT JOIN merchant_subject_claim cc ON cc.application_id=a.id AND cc.id=a.current_credit_claim_id AND cc.id=d.credit_claim_id AND cc.claim_type='CREDIT_CODE' AND cc.status='ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN merchant_subject_claim ic ON ic.application_id=a.id AND ic.id=a.current_identity_claim_id AND ic.id=d.identity_claim_id AND ic.claim_type='IDENTITY_NUMBER' AND ic.status='ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN merchant mer ON mer.id=a.reserved_merchant_id AND mer.owner_user_id=a.owner_user_id LEFT JOIN merchant_profile_compat profile ON profile.merchant_id=a.reserved_merchant_id AND profile.application_id=a.id AND profile.source_revision_id=a.submitted_revision_id WHERE a.reserved_merchant_id=#{merchantId}
SELECT * FROM merchant_application_revision WHERE application_id=#{applicationId} AND id=#{revisionId}

SELECT m.id,m.private_asset_id,m.material_type,m.sha256,m.media_type,m.bytes,rm.position FROM merchant_application_revision_material rm JOIN merchant_application_material m ON m.application_id=rm.application_id AND m.id=rm.material_id WHERE rm.application_id=#{applicationId} AND rm.revision_id=#{revisionId} ORDER BY rm.material_type,rm.position

SELECT id,application_id,submitted_revision_id,submission_no,status,claimed_by_operator_id,claimed_at,version FROM merchant_application_review_task WHERE application_id=#{applicationId} AND id=#{taskId}

SELECT id,application_id,submitted_revision_id,submission_no,status,claimed_by_operator_id,claimed_at,version FROM merchant_application_review_task WHERE application_id=#{applicationId} AND id=#{taskId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id,submitted_revision_id,decision_type,opinion,decided_at FROM merchant_application_review_decision WHERE application_id=#{applicationId} AND id=#{decisionId}

SELECT id,material_id,material_type,credential_type,evidence_status,subject_name_protected,identifier_lookup_digest,lookup_policy_slot,lookup_key_version,valid_from,valid_to FROM merchant_credential_evidence WHERE application_id=#{applicationId} AND revision_id=#{revisionId} AND evidence_status='VERIFIED' ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE

SELECT e.id,e.material_id,e.material_type,e.credential_type,e.evidence_status,e.valid_from,e.valid_to FROM merchant_application_revision_material rm JOIN merchant_application_material mat ON mat.application_id=rm.application_id AND mat.id=rm.material_id JOIN merchant_credential_evidence e ON e.application_id=rm.application_id AND e.material_id=rm.material_id AND e.material_sha256=mat.sha256 WHERE rm.application_id=#{applicationId} AND rm.revision_id=#{revisionId} AND e.evidence_status IN('SUCCEEDED','VERIFIED') ORDER BY e.material_id,e.id

SELECT id,evidence_id,claim_type,lookup_digest,lookup_policy_slot,lookup_key_version,status FROM merchant_subject_claim WHERE application_id=#{applicationId} AND status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY claim_type,id FOR UPDATE
SELECT key_version FROM merchant_subject_lookup_policy WHERE policy_slot=1 AND algorithm='HMAC-SHA-256' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE merchant_application SET current_revision_id=#{revisionId},version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{applicationId} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status IN('DRAFT','REJECTED')

UPDATE merchant_application SET application_no=COALESCE(application_no,#{applicationNo}),status='REVIEWING',submitted_revision_id=#{revisionId},current_revision_id=#{revisionId},current_review_task_id=#{taskId},current_decision_id=NULL,current_decision_type=NULL,review_audit_id=NULL,subject_verification_status=#{subjectStatus},submitted_at=#{now},reviewed_at=NULL,version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{applicationId} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND current_revision_id=#{revisionId} AND status IN('DRAFT','REJECTED')

UPDATE merchant_application_review_task SET status='CLAIMED',claimed_by_operator_id=#{operatorId},claimed_at=#{now},version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{taskId} AND application_id=#{applicationId} AND status='AVAILABLE' AND version=#{expectedVersion}

UPDATE merchant_application_review_task SET status='AVAILABLE',claimed_by_operator_id=NULL,claimed_at=NULL,version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{taskId} AND application_id=#{applicationId} AND status='CLAIMED' AND claimed_by_operator_id=#{operatorId} AND version=#{expectedVersion}
UPDATE merchant_subject_claim SET status='RELEASED',released_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='ACTIVE'

UPDATE merchant_application SET current_credit_claim_id=#{creditClaimId},current_credit_claim_type='CREDIT_CODE',current_credit_claim_status='ACTIVE',current_identity_claim_id=#{identityClaimId},current_identity_claim_type='IDENTITY_NUMBER',current_identity_claim_status='ACTIVE',subject_verification_status='VERIFIED',version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{applicationId} AND status='REVIEWING' AND version=#{expectedVersion}

UPDATE merchant_application_review_task SET status='CLOSED',closed_at=#{now},version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{taskId} AND application_id=#{applicationId} AND status='CLAIMED' AND claimed_by_operator_id=#{operatorId} AND version=#{expectedVersion}

UPDATE merchant_application SET status=#{status},current_decision_id=#{decisionId},current_decision_type=#{decisionType},review_audit_id=#{auditId},reviewed_at=#{now},version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{applicationId} AND status='REVIEWING' AND version=#{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM merchant_application a JOIN merchant_application_revision r ON r.application_id=a.id AND r.id=a.submitted_revision_id WHERE a.status IN('REVIEWING','APPROVED','REJECTED') AND a.status=#{status}AND r.merchant_type_code=#{merchantTypeCode}AND r.city_code=#{cityCode}

SELECT a.id applicationId,a.application_no applicationNo,a.reserved_merchant_id reservedMerchantId,a.status,a.version,a.submitted_revision_id submittedRevisionId,a.subject_verification_status subjectVerificationStatus,r.merchant_name merchantName,r.merchant_type_code merchantTypeCode,r.city_code cityCode,a.submitted_at submittedAt,t.status taskStatus FROM merchant_application a JOIN merchant_application_revision r ON r.application_id=a.id AND r.id=a.submitted_revision_id JOIN merchant_application_review_task t ON t.application_id=a.id AND t.id=a.current_review_task_id WHERE a.status IN('REVIEWING','APPROVED','REJECTED') AND a.status=#{status}AND r.merchant_type_code=#{merchantTypeCode}AND r.city_code=#{cityCode}AND a.submitted_at >= #{submittedFrom}AND a.submitted_at <= #{submittedTo}AND (a.application_no=#{keyword} OR r.merchant_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) ORDER BY a.submitted_at DESC,a.id DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{limit}
SELECT id,canonical_version,params_sha256,params_canonical,status,receipt_json FROM merchant_command_idempotency WHERE request_key=#{requestKey} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE merchant_command_idempotency SET status='SUCCEEDED',receipt_json=#{receiptJson},succeeded_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE request_key=#{requestKey} AND status='RESERVED'
